svg.title: WP-S-03 Figure 3-1: safety mechanisms
svg.desc: Safety mechanisms: SM-01 Longitudinal envelope runs on CMP-02, uses CMP-03, CMP-07, FTTI of SG-01 500–707 ms; SM-02 Lateral envelope runs on CMP-02, uses CMP-03, CMP-07, FTTI of SG-04 447–775 ms; SM-03 Achieved-against-commanded monitor runs on CMP-02, uses CMP-07, CMP-06, FTTI of SG-04 447–707 ms; SM-04 Unconfirmed-braking limiter runs on CMP-02, uses CMP-03, no time budget; SM-05 Command stream watchdog runs on CMP-02, FTTI of SG-08 357 ms; SM-06 Stop, hold and release runs on CMP-02, uses CMP-06, CMP-07, CMP-08, CMP-09, FTTI of SG-05 516–894 ms; SM-07 Indicator cross-check runs on CMP-02, uses CMP-07, no time budget; SM-08 Monitor self-diagnostics and fail-silent output runs on CMP-02, FTTI of SG-07 447–707 ms; SM-09 Geometric obstacle detection runs on CMP-03, uses CMP-04, CMP-05, FTTI of SG-02 500–707 ms; SM-10 Safety channel sensor diagnostics runs on CMP-03, uses CMP-04, CMP-05, FTTI of SG-02 500–707 ms; SM-11 Propulsion cut runs on CMP-06, no time budget; SM-12 Secondary brake path runs on CMP-06, no time budget; SM-13 Fault-tolerant steering for the stop runs on CMP-06, no time budget; SM-14 Stop on loss of the monitor runs on CMP-06, FTTI of SG-07 447–707 ms; SM-15 Independent vehicle state runs on CMP-07, FTTI of SG-04 447–707 ms; SM-16 Park brake hold runs on CMP-08, no time budget; SM-17 Door interlock runs on CMP-09, no time budget; SM-18 Independent monitor supply runs on CMP-10, no time budget; SM-19 Remote command protection runs on CMP-11, no time budget.
svg.text: Where each safety mechanism runs, and how fast it must act
WP-S-03 §3, Figure 3-1: the component each mechanism runs on (filled) and uses (outlined), and its share of the fault tolerant time interval
from WP-S-04. Budgets are computed ranges, not measurements.
Runs on Safety monitor controller; uses Safety
FTTI of SG-01: 500–707 ms (largest fault first)
Reaction: MRM-4 Safety monitor stop in lane

speed, and commands the braking that keeps the safe
longitudinal distance to every road user and
obstacle the safety channel reports, including
across conflict areas and at occlusions; applies the

the current speed and rejects steering whose swept
path comes within the safe lateral distance of a
detected road user, obstacle or kerb
